title: 2023 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: NASA’s Perseverance Rover was launched on July \(30,\) \(2020.\) After traveling \(292{,}526{,}838\) miles, it landed on Mars in Jezero Crater about \(6.5\) months later. Which of the following is closest to the Rover’s average interplanetary speed in miles per hour?

solutions.text:
We can round the distance to \(300{,}000{,}000\) miles and approximate \(6.5\) months as \[ 30 \times 6.5 = 195 \approx 200 \] days.

This gives \[ 300{,}000{,}000 \div 200 = 1{,}500{,}000 \] miles per day.

Dividing by \(24\) gives about \(62{,}500\) miles per hour, which is closest to \(60{,}000.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Convert miles per day to miles per hour by dividing by \(24\)
